verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents employer-side H-1B work as a service. It helps 'specialty workers and their employers' with the H-1B transfer and lottery (registration) process, offers corporate immigration for extensions, amendments and client-site H-1Bs, and covers H-1B petitions and transfers to 'hire and retain global teams.' missing for 10: any mention of LCA compliance, explicit description of employer paperwork/compliance obligations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: We help specialty workers and their employers navigate the H-1B visa transfer and lottery process.
H-1B, L-1, and employment-based visas to hire and retain global teams.
Extensions, amendments, and H-1Bs for employees to consult at client sites are also possible.
Covers O-1A, H-1B, L-1, E-3, and TN petitions and transfers with absolute cost certainty.
